doc: Radial (spin) blur: average of the premultiplied rgba over an arc around (centerX, centerY) (fractions of the document), total arc `amount` degrees centred on each pixel's own angle (+-amount/2). Taps: ceil(arc length in px at the pixel's radius), capped at 64, equally weighted, bilinear, rotating the pixel about the centre; outside the document is transparent. Quality: while radius * amount(rad) <= 64 px the tap spacing is <= 1 px (smooth); beyond that the spacing grows (e.g. 180 deg at 300 px radius: ~15 px between taps) and fine detail shows faint stepping. Reads the whole document in principle (extent = document).

amount.doc: total arc, centred on the pixel's angle
